title: UI风格#19 - Memphis Design (孟菲斯设计)
description: 创建第19种UI风格：孟菲斯设计风格 - 几何图案、撞色组合、80年代后现代。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planS.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When color palette Then features bright primaries with black, pink, electric blue
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #FF3B3B red, #2ECC71 green, #3498DB blue, #F39C12 yellow, #E91E8B pink, #000000 black

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When typography Then uses playful fonts: Bubblegum Sans, Pacifico, or Fredoka One
Given Memphis Design style When layout Then scattered shapes, zigzags, dots, confetti patterns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: scattered geometric shapes, zigzag dividers, dot patterns, confetti decorations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When UI elements Then playful shapes, striped patterns, terazzo textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: mixed shape buttons, striped borders, terrazzo textures, bounce animations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design UI When functional Then includes playful chat, shape agents, confetti stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: playful chat with shapes, colorful agent cards, confetti-style stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design UI When copy Then uses playful language: 'Fun', 'Play', 'Joy', 'Sparkle'
